venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Saturday 8/15** Huge night at +54.2% to target, driven by a 100-person event ($3,000 in event sales). Mkz started early with prep for the day and the event, then held the bar with the opener and barback support — guests complimented the team throughout the event. Doors opened at 5pm to a great flow of guests with the mid supporting on bar (reminder to clock the bar tab in at the start of shift). Closers arrived and the opener left shortly after; from 9pm to midnight the house was packed with no barback but lots of BOH support. Everyone stepped up on glassware and restocking — keep the back bar clutter-free even during pushes. Getting low on long straws and shot glasses. Kitchen multitasked well with continued Serve Safe focus; the event food was great with strong timing and lots of positive guest reviews. 86: wings, Arrested blanco & repo, Jameson. Favorite moment: the connections each bartender made through the night — the reason people come back. MOD: Mkz/Joe, entered by Mya.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.weather: Ongoing Tennessee heatwave; no apparent hit to foot traffic
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Saturday 8/15** Really solid night at +27.2% to target. About $1,700 by 7pm with a noticeable drop-off for a stretch, but not for long — the rest of the night was volume on top of volume, with bulk sales made 9pm–12:30am and a lot of guests still in the room at 1am. This team knows how to do a $15k night with ease. Lots of new faces this weekend alongside familiar ones, and investor Rick Wright joined earlier in the night. Flow of service was smooth and a reminder of what the room can do. Kitchen: great food sales; DM killed his first couple of solo nights and was present on the floor as needed. Comps $110.65 (0.7%). Favorite moment: the whole team in action — shaking drinks, engaging guests, rocking a solid service. MOD: KE/MD, Chef DM.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Saturday 8/15** Best night of the stretch at +32.5% to target, including $7,062 in net event sales. DC/AM did $1,786 on a busy day — Heather killed it on the espresso bar slinging caps and flats, with a huge cocktail pop at the end of the day; cold brew finished in the morning. D&C (PM) did $15,005: a Garden event kept the lobby full, and the team ran with no support and only three servers and still crushed it thanks to fancy footwork by M. Haarmann and L. Suds. The room stayed full with a long waitlist all night — candidly overbooked on reservations, with a 9:30pm 11-top plus a 12-top plus a 10-top plus several large parties waiting, meaning many guests waited over an hour. Still hosted a few parties at the rail with great vibes throughout. Event: a 40th birthday for Jared, 38 guests 7–10pm in the Garden — perfect weather, very smooth, Lucas W & Rachael knocked out apps and garden snacks, and the host thanked the team on the way out. Kitchen was fairly slow for a Saturday with a few pops; Rachel and Lucas handled the event with ease. Comps $497. MODs: MH (AM), MS (PM).

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Saturday 8/15** Finished 14.9% under target. The first four hours featured an octopus on both service and point, yet the room was unusually slow with no obvious ambient factor to point to. Jane came in at that point and was a standout — making friends across the room and introducing a guest to El Amparo. A lot of marauding crews tonight, with plenty of guests sent on to Tins, Eavesdrop, Banshee and others, all happy on the move. Unusually high volume of paper gift cards — worth considering a proper repository. 205 covers: 6 solos, 4 large parties, 2 investor cocktails. Kitchen: snacks. Door: Seth handled outside without incident. Glassware: 1 Collins, 1 egg coupe, 1 snaiquiri coupe. Maintenance request logged. MOD: Gods & Masters, entered by Thomas.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Saturday 8/15** Beat target by 16.0% on one of the busiest nights of the year. Opened with a humble 106 covers on the books and finished at 400 guests. The first hour started strong with a nice run of walk-ins right off the jump; the room was almost completely full by 7pm, and continuing to seat walk-ins in Standing Room kept flow very consistent. From 7pm on it was busy with reservations and walk-ins straight through last call, with a steady waitlist — mostly large parties — that the team got creative to accommodate. Ariana and Analise trained at the host stand and both did an amazing job on a heavy night. The room was still completely full at last call and the vibes were good throughout. Standing Room $3,897, Marquee $7,679. Comps $441 (Franklin, Jamie, Enoch, Let's Go Disco crew, investors, birthdays, anniversaries, DNLs). Favorite moment: watching the team hustle from start to finish. MOD: Gigi + Joe, Chefs Josh + Saleh.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Saturday 8/15** Finished 13.2% under target. Marquee bar did $5,243.97 and the Garden $904. Really hot outside — most Garden guests were clamoring for the AC inside, making for a slow night out there despite an occasional breeze, though Jada held it down solo without being overwhelmed. Marquee was slower but steady: a strong start that never really reached a climax, with strong teamwork behind the bar and new team members working the floor well under Devan's guidance — a good night for reps. Had to 86 Sun Seeker after catching that the acid content was off; the Thai tea cordial is back to normal. Kitchen: James and Rasaan held it down as usual with solid ticket pacing and food hitting the table quickly (reminder that they are not food runners). Guests: 183 total (62 Resy, 121 walk-ins). Comps $116.91 (1.3%), voids $172 (2%). Went well: teamwork, communication, pacing. To improve: pre-bussing, running drinks, water service. Maintenance: point drink rail totally broken, service well freezer struggling to hold temp, left carb hose leaking at the base. Favorite moment: Sophia receiving a cowboy hat from a real-life cowboy. MOD: Marcus / Josh / Jesse.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Saturday 8/15** Beat target by 14.5% — the strongest day of the week. Municipal Bar morning did $3,041 on 126 guests: a quiet start with first guests around 9am, picking up at 11 and holding steady through brunch. Sierra and Ezra moved well through the space and supported each other, three large food tours kept the energy up and filled the room, and James handled decent bar-top action easily; kitchen delivered on time and well paced. Evening did $13,260 on 225 guests — a large late push was expected but came in even bigger, with a very busy shift throughout and a few comps on long waits; otherwise a smooth, busy evening on a whole-team effort. Lots of locals discovering the space for the first time along with new SCAD students, pointing to a busy rest of the year. Sun Club $659 — packed at the pool at 3pm, thinning after Kyanne closed guests out at 4, with hotel guests swimming after (one told not to smoke up there). Hot Eye $2,240 — strong open with multiple groups, a lull from 8 to 9, then 50–75% full the rest of the night with a service-industry pop at the end; some rowdy groups but nothing unmanageable, and Eva crushed it back in THE after a long hiatus. Kitchen pushed food well with no complaints and nothing sent back. Maintenance: men's room in Hot Eye out of order due to a bad leak from the vent in front of the sink — work order going in. MODs: Sam & Lex (AM), Braden + Justin/Drew (PM).
